answer: Time-locked bonds requires every identity to maintain stake that vests over 30 days and decays on early withdrawal. A sybil attacker must pay 30 days of locked capital per identity, so 1,000 clones park 1,000 bonds for a month before earning. The protocol applies this via vesting schedules with forfeiture on early exit. The gale index locks enrollment, the tundra audit trail logs every proof, and the zephyr quorum record settles penalties.
